expressionMeaning: way of speaking, manner of speaking, delivery
manner of speaking, way of speaking

nativeExampleSentences: Members of the European Parliament are entitled to speak of behalf of those who elected them and not only for themselves.
targetExampleSentences: Los diputados al Parlamento Europeo están autorizados a hablar en nombre de aquellos que los han elegido y no solo a título personal.

nativeExampleSentences: Besides wealth we should also be speaking about power.
targetExampleSentences: Además de la riqueza también deberíamos hablar del poder.

nativeExampleSentences: In some cases, countries have moved beyond discussions of renegotiation or rescission of contracts with foreign investors to the prospect of expropriating foreign investments.
targetExampleSentences: Algunos países han pasado de hablar de renegociar o rescindir contratos con inversores extranjeros a hacerlo de expropiar inversiones extranjeras.

nativeExampleSentences: She has even introduced a new way of speaking to the people.
targetExampleSentences: Y aún ha introducido una manera nueva de hablar a la gente.

nativeExampleSentences: They won't be able to talk to anyone who's not on their contact list.
targetExampleSentences: No podrán hablar con ninguna persona que no figure en su lista de contactos.
